topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These remarks introduce the lecture topic, connect it to previous practical work, and outline the day's learning outcomes.

topics.label: Tumor Viruses, Proto-Oncogenes, and Assays for Cellular Transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the study of viral transmission and retroviruses led to the discovery of cellular proto-oncogenes and experimental methods for testing cell transformation.

topics.label: Functional Mechanisms of Oncogenes and Tumor Suppressor Genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the definitions, cell-cycle regulatory roles, and mutational mechanisms distinguishing oncogenes from tumor suppressor genes.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Consequences of Genetic Instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how defects in DNA repair, replication proofreading, and mitotic chromosome segregation produce sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multistep Tumor Progression and Hereditary Cancer Predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss how the sequential accumulation of somatic and germline mutations drives tumor progression, hereditary cancer syndromes, and subsequent tumor evolution.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: These remarks conclude the lecture, summarize the covered outcomes, and provide suggested reading materials.
